name: Malayan Cement Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订事项；公告主要为季度业绩、股息除权及股份上市相关。最新一季（2026-09-30）营收同比增长9.5%，净利润同比增长13.5%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not disclose any expansion, new business, reduction, disposal, or contract wins for its business segments in its announcements; announcements mainly covered quarterly results, dividend ex-dates, and share listings. Latest quarter (2026-09-30) revenue grew 9.5% YoY and net profit grew 13.5% YoY.
